purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: SEC Credit-Rating Recordkeeping Orders, 2024–2026
question: What did the SEC's September 3, 2024 recordkeeping actions against six credit rating agencies establish, what later remediation did they require, and what could the public verify by March 3, 2026?
bluf: The six September 3, 2024 SEC orders were final admitted enforcement objects: all six NRSROs accepted censures, cease-and-desist relief and penalties totaling more than $49 million. Four orders also required independent-consultant remediation, but their main reports and related communications were expressly nonpublic. By the March 3, 2026 comparison cutoff, the public record proves a mandatory remediation architecture, not the contents or successful completion of that process.
